conviction_note: Four findings that genuinely cut both ways sum to about -1: the strongest derivable fact is that Q2 2026 laps the best quarter of 2025 (RMB295.2m, +57.5% YoY) right after Q1 2026 printed exactly flat YoY, so the growth headline this stock has historically traded off will read ~0% for a second straight quarter; that is partly offset by a genuine sequential recovery, a new wheelchair revenue line and an inflecting cloud/AI segment, and with no option chain, essentially no analyst coverage and ~5,500 ADS a day of volume there is no priced expectation to lean against in either direction, so a small signed number is the honest output.

findings.finding: Q2 2026 laps the single strongest quarter of 2025 - revenue RMB295.2m, +57.5% YoY, explicitly the company's best since Q1 2021 - immediately after Q1 2026 revenue came in at RMB259.0m, exactly flat against Q1 2025's RMB259m (derived: Q2 2025 was +14.0% QoQ off RMB295.2m), so the Q2 headline will almost certainly show a second consecutive quarter of zero growth for a company whose entire 2026 narrative is FY2025's +42.6%.
findings.why_not_priced: There is one published estimate on the name and no option chain, so there is no consensus revenue line for the market to have marked down; if the comp were priced the stock would not be up 15.6% in 20 days into the print, and the Q1 stall (which cost -9.33% on 2026-06-10) would have left the shares flat-to-lower rather than 25% off the August low. Every wire item on this company still leads with '43% revenue growth' from the FY2025 release.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 release confirms the RMB259.0m and the flat-YoY framing, and the segment rates that produce a ~flat Q2 (internet services -15.2%, global enterprise services -10.5%, robotics +175.9%): https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/cheetah-mobile-announces-first-quarter-2026-unaudited-consolidated-financial-results-302796536.html - note this Q1 release is the same document underlying finding 4, so treat the pair as one source cluster.

findings.finding: The 'cash exceeds market cap' framing is wrong on the actual filings: operating cash flow was -RMB238.3m in 2024 and -RMB172.3m in 2025, cash and equivalents fell RMB1,833.0m (Dec-2024) to RMB1,506.6m (Dec-2025) to RMB1,280.6m (Mar-2026) - down 30%, roughly US$75m, against a US$108m market cap - and total liabilities of RMB2,497.9m exceed cash plus long-term investments of RMB1,972.8m, with the Q1 cash fall of RMB226m matched almost exactly by a RMB297.6m drop in accrued expenses and other current liabilities.
findings.why_not_priced: Every secondary write-up quotes the gross 'US$185.6 million of cash and US$100.3 million of long-term investments' as the value support - the sweep brief that commissioned this hunt does the same - and none nets the RMB2.5bn of liabilities or shows the two-year negative operating cash flow. If it were priced, a 0.43x-book name with a US$186m cash line and a shrinking share count would not trade at US$108m without a single analyst netting the balance sheet; there has been no buyback authorised since the 2018 programme expired in September 2019.
findings.independence: Balance-sheet detail and the RMB1,280.6m / RMB2,497.9m figures come from the Q1 2026 6-K exhibit, a different document: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1597835/000119312526264835/cmcm-ex99_1.htm . A third party independently flags the liability structure (93.5% short-term) and US$80.28m of goodwill as impairment risk: https://www.hdinresearch.com/news/1329 (2026-04-29). Caveat that cuts the other way: cash ROSE from RMB1,833.0m to RMB2,019.6m over H1 2025 before collapsing in H2, so the June-30 balance may print up sequentially and not trigger this read at this particular print - hence the positive tail on the band.

findings.finding: Cheetah's cloud/AI-infrastructure line - the growth half of the Global Enterprise Services segment that fell 10.5% YoY in Q1 only because advertising-agency revenue halved (-51.5%) - grew 68.3% YoY in Q1 and management disclosed on the Q1 call that daily token throughput was up more than 20x since January, exceeding 400 million tokens a day in May 2026, i.e. a mid-Q2 operating datapoint showing the segment accelerating inside the quarter being reported.
findings.why_not_priced: The 20x/400m-tokens figure exists only in the earnings-call transcript, not in the press release, and no wire item, aggregator or estimate carries it; the segment's headline number in every summary is 'Global Enterprise Services -10.5%'. If the market had this, the GES line would be framed as inflecting rather than declining. Sized small deliberately because token throughput is an engagement proxy, not revenue - the resale economics are thin and the offset against a collapsing ad-agency book is only worth single-digit RMB millions a quarter.
findings.independence: The 68.3% cloud/AI growth rate is corroborated in the separate Q1 press release: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/cheetah-mobile-announces-first-quarter-2026-unaudited-consolidated-financial-results-302796536.html , and the company's own marketing site shows the enterprise/overseas arm actively pushing its TapLeap WhatsApp platform through Aug-Sep 2026 trade fairs: https://overseas.cmcm.com/news (2026-09-02).

findings.finding: Cheetah's intelligent wheelchair had an overseas order in hand as of 1 April 2026 with shipments expected to begin in Q2 2026 - the exact quarter being reported - a brand-new hardware line on top of a robotics segment that was already the only growing part of the business (+175.9% YoY in Q1, RMB60m and +93.6% in Q4 2025).
findings.why_not_priced: This is a Chinese-language Economic Observer piece (URL path /2026/0401/) that has no English-language equivalent and appears in no US wire, aggregator or estimate; the only English trace is an unnamed reference on the Q1 call to 'initial product shipments to a top global designer and manufacturer of mobility products'. If it were priced, the robotics story on this name would be discussed as a smart-mobility story rather than as service robots plus UFactory arms.
findings.independence: Corroborated by management on the Q1 2026 call describing initial shipments to a top global mobility-products manufacturer and to China's leading elderly scooter maker: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/cheetah-mobile-cmcm-q1-2026-213221362.html (2026-06-10) - same transcript as finding 3, so count the transcript once. Independent confirmation that OrionStar has extended its stack into smart mobility: https://cn.orionstar.com/gsjj.html

searched_and_found_nothing: SEC EDGAR full 2026 filing list: only two 6-Ks all year (2026-03-24 and 2026-06-10, both earnings) plus the 20-F - no quiet 8-K-equivalent, no ADS ratio change, no delisting or NYSE compliance notice, no board or auditor change (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001597835&type=6-K)

Share repurchase: nothing since the US$100m programme authorised 2018-09-13 that expired 2019-09-12 with ~4.5m ADS bought for ~US$32.3m; no 2025 or 2026 authorisation found despite 0.43x book (https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/cheetah-mobile-announces-us100-million-share-repurchase-program-300712070.html)

EasyClaw traction: launched 2026-03-07, no download, MAU, revenue or pricing disclosure found anywhere - Google Play listing would not render install counts, and the Capterra/AlternativeTo listings carry no user numbers, so the AI-agent narrative that took the stock to ~$9 has no measurable monetisation to check
Hong Kong secondary listing or an OrionStar / UFactory carve-out IPO - searched Chinese sources, nothing found
OrionStar or UFactory product launches, large orders or government awards dated July-September 2026 - nothing in Chinese or English media
No option chain worth reading (228 total open interest, ATM legs not two-sided), so no skew, no implied move, and no positioning signal of any kind
Insider Form 4 / 13D-G activity - not applicable, foreign private issuer, nothing filed
baseline_tension: The baseline offers nothing to lean against - no implied move, no skew, and a reaction history the sweep itself flags as contaminated by non-earnings 6-Ks (of the eight, 2025-07-28 is the UFactory acquisition announcement and 2025-06-20 is an annual-report filing) - so the only baseline number with content is the +15.6% 20-day run-up, and my modestly negative net sum cuts against it, though on 5,511 ADS a day (~US$19k of turnover) that run-up is a handful of retail tickets and should not be read as positioning by anyone, including the ranker.
